Write detector responses as WFDB rhythm annotations

write_wfdb_rhythm.Rd

WFDB test annotation files describe rhythm as a state that holds until the next rhythm annotation. They cannot express abstention or missing input: every stretch of time is some rhythm. This writer therefore needs an explicit label for responses other than positive, and the choice is recorded by the caller.

Usage

write_wfdb_rhythm(path, predictions, fs, positive_label = "(AFIB",
  other_label = "(N", start_sample = 0)

Arguments

path

Output annotation file.

predictions

Prediction rows of one record and detector (columns start, end, response), in seconds.

fs

Sampling frequency in Hz.

positive_label,other_label

Rhythm labels for positive and for all other responses (negative, abstain, uncovered time).

start_sample

Sample at which the first rhythm label starts.

Value

path, invisibly.
